narrative.headline: Smart money is loading semiconductor and storage hardware exposure with conviction, while bifurcating sharply within the same industries.
bullish_themes: Storage/memory hardware is the highest-conviction trade: SNDK ($79.7M), MU ($33.8M), WDC ($18.9M), and STX all show 80%+ bullish flow with heavy ask-side prints
Semiconductor equipment buyers are concentrated in LRCX and AMKR despite KLAC/TER/ENTG showing aggressive bearish flow in the same industry — name selection matters here
Networking and AI infrastructure adjacency: ANET ($4.7M), APH, QCOM, and AVGO all bid with size
Industrial electrification names (EOSE, PWR, TE, AEIS) provide a secondary bullish cluster tied to power/grid buildout
notable_individual_flows: SNDK: $79.7M premium, 82% bullish, 43 ask-side prints — single largest conviction trade in the scan
MU: $33.8M at 89% bullish with 46 ask-side prints — clean memory cycle bet
WDC: $18.9M, 82% bullish — confirms storage theme alongside SNDK
AMD vs MU split: AMD shows $35M at 70% bearish while MU shows $33M at 89% bullish — explicit pair-trade signal
EOSE: $1.6M at 95% bullish with 21 ask-side prints — smaller name but unusually clean tape
narrative.absences: Despite XLK dominating the bullish list, no flow in mega-cap software (MSFT, ORCL, CRM, ADBE) or in NVDA itself — the tech bid is narrowly hardware/semis, not platform software. Healthcare, energy, staples, and discretionary are entirely absent from the bullish tape.
